artifacts.purpose: Pass/fail proof that required harness components exist, are tracked, and are wired together.

artifacts.purpose: Framework-dependent Windows dashboard build artifact.

artifacts.generator: sas context, sas next, and AutoLogon field orchestration
artifacts.purpose: Persistent machine-local operator state containing repo branch/ref, network classification, requested and canonical target, exact eligibility proof state, historical recovery state, deployment state, evidence path, and one exact next action.
Crash-safe machine-local index of bounded discovered deployment/runtime artifact paths, public state fields, timestamps, and next-action guidance. No network or target contact is performed.

artifacts.generator: sas cybernet Probe HOST or the integrated readiness stage inside sas cybernet Deploy HOST
artifacts.purpose: One-target staged Kerberos SMB plus Task Scheduler readiness result. CYBERNET_DEPLOYMENT_READINESS_READY proves read-only transport readiness only; no task creation, package execution, target mutation, restart, or runtime acceptance.

artifacts.generator: Run-CybernetClientConfiguration.cmd Plan HOST or Run-CybernetClientConfiguration.cmd Apply HOST
artifacts.purpose: Historical full Cybernet client plan/apply summary; not the current software deployment completion artifact.

artifacts.generator: Deploy-CybernetClinicalCore.cmd Plan HOST or Deploy-CybernetClinicalCore.cmd Deploy HOST
artifacts.purpose: Five-package clinical-core stage summary. CLINICAL_CORE_DEPLOYMENT_COMPLETED proves that stage only; AutoLogon and restart are separate later stages.
Internal live S4U apply artifact. KERBEROS_S4U_AUTOLOGON_CONFIGURED_REBOOT_PROOF_PENDING is a pre-reboot gate and is not deployment completion.
Supporting inner restart-wrapper result. It proves S4U apply and restart behavior but is not the canonical normal-product outer transaction artifact.

artifacts.generator: sas autologon Remote HOST or sas autologon Recover HOST
artifacts.purpose: Canonical outer AutoLogon field transaction artifact. AUTOLOGON_DEPLOYMENT_RESTART_COMPLETED requires protected network proof, canonical target resolution, exact local host eligibility, recovery convergence, atomic apply-once admission, S4U apply, bounded restart observation, and cleanup verification.

Canonical full Cybernet software deployment artifact. CYBERNET_SOFTWARE_DEPLOYMENT_COMPLETED_RESTARTED proves the integrated low-noise readiness passed, the five clinical applications completed before AutoLogon, AutoLogon ran last, and the required restart cycle completed.
Optional higher-ceiling actual-session AutoLogon runtime artifact. It is not required for deployment completion.
Ignored local run context, registry, English report, summary, and handoff for synthetic harness proof.
Per-run inventory of source, generated, evidence, report, and handoff artifacts.

artifacts.consumption: clean local pipe and direct human review
artifacts.purpose: Clean local text handoff containing the human-readable next action, proof ceiling, failures, and artifact locations; it is not parser-facing evidence.
Compressed next-agent handoff with repo, branch, scope, validation, Git state, and next command.
